mapper.sql: id, doc_id, workspace_id, version_no, title, format, saved_by, saved_by_user_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement_doc_history (id, doc_id, workspace_id, version_no, title, content, format, saved_by, saved_by_user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{docId}, #{workspaceId}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{format}, #{savedBy}, #{savedByUserId}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT , content FROM requirement_doc_history WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM requirement_doc_history WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM requirement_doc_history WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
